Phishing website me suspicious URLs, grammatical errors aur unsolicited requests hoti hai. Agar galti se data daal diya to immediately password update karo.

Yeh phishing scam pehle 2023, 2025 aur 2026 mein bhi hua. Agar aapke mobile ki screen ke URL dekh lo, to kuch nahi hoga.
Supreme Court ki asli website sirf sci.gov.in hai. Dusre links avoid karo aur URL hover karke dekh lo.
goal: Phishing scam se bachne ke liye, URL check karo aur data nahi daalna.
